rows.claim: The weighted figure is lower than the plain mean because latam, the lowest-scoring region, carries the largest weight.
rows.evidence: The tool outputs show the weights (latam 2.1 is the largest) and the two results (mean 3.504, weighted 3.448). They never show per-region mean satisfaction scores. The agent never computed them, so the claim that latam is the lowest-scoring region and the cause of the gap is not shown by any tool output. The data listing suggests latam scores are low, but that was not verified.
